cues.text: At Chihiro's home, in her room, you sit with her on cushions on the floor, Chihiro kneeling with her hands folded in her lap.
Chihiro holds out a book, and you lean over and take it.
You get up to leave and start toward the door. Chihiro looks up, startled, and scrambles to her feet.
You turn back, walk over to Chihiro and draw her close. She looks startled.
